newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banco Bozano H1 net slips to 90 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banco Bozano H1 net slips to 90 mln reais.

text.p: Brazil's Banco Bozano, Simonsen on Monday said its first-half net profit fell to 90 million reais from 97 million reais in the same period last year.

Paulo Ferraz, president of the investment bank, said the bank's net profit in the first half mostly reflected revenues from trading, credit operations and fees stemming from asset management, corporate finance and brokerage activities.

Last year's first-half performance included 36 million reais of revenue from a contract to run Banco do Estado do Rio de Janeiro SA, or Banerj, the Rio de Janeiro state bank that was privatized in June 1997, he said.
Bozano ended the January-to-June period with total assets of 8.4 billion reais, net worth of 610 million reais and an annualized return on equity of 30 percent, he said.
The bank manages 5.5 billion reais in assets, he said.
